summary: Two CodeTabs groups, each with cURL and Node.js tabs, that share the selected language through the same sync key.
use: API docs that show the same request in several languages and keep the choice in sync across the page.
spec: Two `<CodeTabs sync="demo-lang">` blocks use the same sync key
Each group has `<CodeTab label="cURL">` and `<CodeTab label="Node.js">`
Tab content is `<div class="ca-code"><pre><code>` rendering a string constant such as `{curl}` or `{node}`
First group sends a POST to messages/text, second group lists sessions with `{curlList}` and `{nodeList}`
